summary: Fixes the first real schema-2 production backup failure: station.json/updater-bootstrap.json/runtime-state.json were preserved at their real 0600 mode inside the payload, unreadable by the unprivileged isadoraair-backup.service (runs as jreed). Now stored uniformly at 0644 (no secrets present); true restore mode recorded separately in restore_modes and reapplied explicitly at restore time. Also drops a redundant, unused .staging/attestations-<slot>/ copy. No protected-runtime change.
